entities.summary: Helena Třeštíková is a Czech documentary film director. She became known for making “time-lapse” long-term observational documentary films that won many awards. She briefly served as the Minister of Culture of the Czech Republic. From 2017, she is also a university teacher.

entities.summary: Helena Třeštíková is a Czech documentary film director. She became known for making “time-lapse” long-term observational documentary films that won many awards. She briefly served as the Minister of Culture of the Czech Republic. From 2017, she is also a university teacher.
